styles.name: Biscuit stud halter bib apron with a black retail pocket, black contrast neck strap and waist ties through antique brass eyelets — Oliver Harvey, The Peacock at Barlow
styles.desc: BIB APRON · Model FOHDENIM, variant PEACOCK · Retail pocket in the contrast black cotton with two stitch-line pen pockets to the right side of the pocket as worn, set to embroidery pre make-up · Contrast black cotton waist ties through large antique brass eyelets at the waist · Contrast black cotton neck strap, stud fastened with antique brass capped studs · Antique brass rivets to the top corners of the pocket · Red OH tax tab to the left side of the pocket · The Peacock at Barlow logo 15 cm in white, set centrally to the pocket
styles.lectra: FOHDENIM, variant PEACOCK — discard the right side as worn stud re-inforcement piece. Cloth 1 (biscuit) for the main apron, the eyelet re-inforcement pieces and the stud re-inforcement piece; cloth 2 (black 3110) for the pocket, neck strap and waist ties
fabrics: Biscuit ref 2860 LAFCP300 300 gsm 55% cotton / 45% polyester (Utexbel) for the main apron, eyelet re-inforcement pieces and stud re-inforcement piece — rating 0.50 m, the same as All Costings; the sheet gives the location as A6, Sage holds the cloth at B6
Black 3110 100% cotton 255 gsm (P and R) for the pocket, neck strap and waist ties — rating 0.26 m; the sheet gives the location as A5, Sage holds the cloth at A4
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BISCUIT 08569 for the main stitching — cost per metre
THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BLACK 09700: set the pocket and neck strap with black thread on top and spool; the waist ties and neck strap are made in black — cost per metre
Set just below the base of the re-inforcement patch in the right side seam as worn, on top of the OH care label.

Wash and care instructions printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape: main 55% cotton / 45% polyester, contrast 100% cotton · 50° wash · 2 dot iron · P dry clean · do not bleach · tumble dry low. Set below the OH woven label in the right side seam as worn.
Set to the left side of the pocket as worn, level with the top edge.
30E/R AB 30 mm antique brass eyelets, 2 per apron. Set to the top of the side seams: centre of the eyelet 3 cm down from the top and 3 cm in from the side seam, finished.
The ring for each 30 mm eyelet: 2 per apron.
Antique brass capped studs, quality 050B: 4 x male (parts A/B). Sage holds quality 050 as the gilt 15 mm round spring fastener.
Antique brass capped studs, quality 050B: 2 x female (parts C/D).
010B/7P - 011B antique brass invert nipple rivet and post, one at each top corner of the pocket: 2 per apron. No Sage code on the trims list.
mfg: Embroidery: The Peacock at Barlow logo, 15 cm, in white, set centrally to the pocket. The pocket goes to embroidery pre make-up — see CUSTOMER BRANDING.
Set the pocket and neck strap with black thread on top and spool.
Discard the right side as worn stud re-inforcement piece.

Neaten the long edge of the stud re-inforcement piece, turning onto the right side of the fabric, as the wrong side of the fabric is to be uppermost. Set to the left side as worn so it is included in the top of bib turning and the armhole turning. Set so the wrong side is uppermost on the finished garment.
Fold over the bib top 1 + 3.2 cm and topstitch 3 cm.
Edgestitch the top edge.
Set the re-inforcement patches, right side of the fabric uppermost: 6 mm down from the cut edge and 12 mm in from the side seam to reduce bulk. Edgestitch the long edge into position.
Double turn the armholes and topstitch 6 mm.
Double turn the side seams and topstitch 12 mm. Set the labels in the right side seam as worn, just below the base of the re-inforcement patch.
Double turn the hem and topstitch 12 mm.
Change thread to grey. Make the waist ties in the black 3110 cotton: bag out both ends and topstitch one side.
Make the neck strap in the black 3110 cotton: bag out both ends and edgestitch one side.
Set the pocket hem: turn under 1 cm, turn 2 cm and twin needle topstitch, the bottom row of stitching 2 cm from the top of the pocket.

Set the neck strap to the right side of the bib as worn, the edgestitched side of the strap to the inside of the neck as worn to reduce bulk. Set the strap to the bib, box stitch the strap and stitch the X detail. Position the strap so the edgestitching at the base of the strap end is in line with the 3 cm topstitching of the bib.
Set the lower mitred pocket to the apron: base of the finished pocket 29.5 cm up from the finished hem, set centrally within the width of the apron. Twin needle three sides.
Set the pen pocket stitch lines to the right side of the pocket as worn: the first row 3 cm from the inside row of twin needle stitching, 13 cm deep; the second row 3 cm from the first, 13 cm deep.

After the eyelets are set (finishing) the apron comes back for the waist ties: set the tie through the eyelet 4 cm and stitch down to secure, join on the inside as worn. Box stitch 2 stitch wide to the width of the strap.
fin: Set the rivets to the top corners of all pockets.
Set the eyelets: centre of the eyelet 3 cm in from the side seam and 3 cm down from the top of the side seam. The apron goes back to the machinist for the waist ties.

Set the studs: the female capped studs to the strap, central to the width, the first stud 1.5 cm from the end then 4 cm spacing (centre of stud), 4 studs in all. The male studs to the bib, 1.5 cm down and 1.5 cm in from the end of the bib, the second stud 4 cm below and 1.5 cm in from the edge, vertically down, onto the re-inforcement patch.
Check, trim, press and fold. Wrap in tissue and set the product sticker.
styles.tol: Across bib ± 1 cm · Neck strap ± 1 cm · Length ± 1 cm · Width at hem ± 1 cm
styles.brandPlace: The Peacock at Barlow logo, 15 cm wide, embroidered in white centrally to the black retail pocket. The pocket is embroidered pre make-up.
styles.note: Works order OHAPP059668/03 for The Peacock at Barlow, Oliver Harvey (JH created from SR1120 15/5/23; approved for bulk 19/6/23 JH; issued by Jane). The FOHDENIM stud halter apron in the biscuit LAFCP300 cloth with a single black retail pocket in place of the two denim hip pockets of OHAPP059703/DEN, otherwise the same make: black contrast neck strap, waist ties through 30 mm antique brass eyelets, capped studs and rivets. Rating 0.50 m on PC9068, the same as All Costings, and 0.26 m on the black CO5003. The logo is the record's own branding, so it is not a stock style. The sheet's sketch is kept as the placement image. The sheet is in works-orders/OHAPP05966803-PeacockBarlow.xlsx.

styles.name: Storm grey bib apron in poly cotton with self fabric waist ties and a black OH towel loop — Oliver Harvey, Soho Farmhouse
styles.desc: BIB APRON · AP3005 butchers style, variant 3005TIES · No pocket · Self fabric neck strap · Self fabric waist ties · Towel loop in black Oliver Harvey non tangle tape, left side as worn · Soho Farmhouse logo embroidered to the top left-hand corner of the bib as worn
styles.lectra: AP3005 — butchers style, variant 3005TIES (self fabric ties)
fabrics: Storm grey 65% recycled polyester / 35% organic cotton 200 gsm X133ECO-AM299 (Tiajo) — rating 1.00 m with the self fabric ties and neck strap, the same as All Costings; the sheet gives the location as A3, Sage holds the cloth at A5
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S STORM GREY 09963 — cost per metre
Oliver Harvey British button woven label, set into the right side seam as worn, 4 cm down from the top edge.

Oliver Harvey wash instructions set under the OH woven label in the right side seam as worn: 65% recycled polyester / 35% organic cotton · 60° wash · tumble dry · 2 dot iron · do not bleach · P dry clean.
Black Oliver Harvey non tangle tape, cut 15" (38 cm) from the roll; "Oliver Harvey" to read from top to bottom. Cut from the tape Sage holds as the black OH tie CMP-OH-NTT-25-03.
Self fabric, two per apron: no bought-in tie. Bag out one end, fold in half, enclose the raw edges and edgestitch the long edge to close.
Self fabric: fold in half, enclose the raw edges and edge stitch the long edge to close.
mfg: Embroidery: the Soho Farmhouse logo set to the top left-hand corner of the bib as worn — see CUSTOMER BRANDING.
Make neck strap. Fold in half and enclose raw edges. Edge stitch long edge to close seam.
Make waist ties. Bag out one end, fold in half and enclose raw edges. Edgestitch long edge to close.

Set bib facing and insert neck strap. Edge of neck strap to finish in line with side of bib (no step). Edge stitched side of neck strap to be set to outside edge of bib and ensure good side of strap to topside.
Bib facing: fold in 10 mm to neaten lower edge. Edge stitch lower edge of facing, which forms 5.5 cm topstitching to front.
Top of bib 6 mm topstitched.

Armhole double turned and topstitching to finish 6 mm from edge. Cut the towel loop 15", "Oliver Harvey" to read from top to bottom. Position the towel loop 17 cm from the left-hand side of the side seam, folded in half and inserted inside the back waistband, stitched down on the front following the armhole stitching.
Hem double turned and topstitching to finish 12 mm from edge.
Sides double turned and topstitching to finish 12 mm from edge. Neaten the armholes before the side seam is neatened.
Insert the waist tie neatly into the top of the side seam turning. Do NOT roll the tie above the apron seam.
Fold the waist tie back on itself to fall away from the garment and edge stitch down to the width of the strap to secure.
fin: Check, trim, press and fold. Tissue, set the product label to the bottom right-hand corner and then bag.
styles.brandPlace: Soho Farmhouse logo (the green box-and-diagonal motif) embroidered to the top left-hand corner of the bib as worn.
styles.note: Works order OHAP3005248ST for Soho Farmhouse, Oliver Harvey (JH created 6/10/16; created for Soho Farmhouse 27/11/17; YL amended the thread shade 10/1/19; YL eco fabric details, supplier and code 30/10/24). The storm grey OHAP3005 bib apron with self fabric waist ties and neck strap in place of the OH tape ties, a black OH tape towel loop and the Soho Farmhouse logo. Rating 1.00 m on PC2064ECO, the same as All Costings, on the same four-measurement chart as the tape-tie OHAP3005248. The logo is the record's own branding, so it is not a stock style. The sheet's sketch is kept as the placement image. The sheet is in works-orders/OHAP3005248ST-SohoFarmhouse.xlsx.
